title: Healing of two-wall intra-bony defects treated with a novel EMD-liquid-A pre-clinical study in monkeys
authors: Shirakata Y, Miron RJ, Shinohara Y, Nakamura T, Sena K, Horai N, Bosshardt DD, Noguchi K, Sculean A. 2017. J Clin Periodontol.; 44(12):1264-1273. * collacone®
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The present findings indicate that in two -wall intra -bony defects, reconstructive surgery with Osteogain/ACS appears to be a promising novel approach for facilitating periodontal wound healing/regeneration, thus warranting further clinical testing” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
